summary: UI scrollbar input handler: reads a two-axis input position via DualFieldRead, clears the three interaction flags, then classifies the cursor against scrollbar track and arrow-zone boundaries obtained through virtual getters. Within the track, the cursor lands in the scroll-up arrow zone, the scroll-down/thumb zone, the page-up zone, the thumb area, or the page-down zone, each setting a flag and dispatching the matching navigation helper. Outside the track, when content navigation is enabled, computes a target content index via sub_489F40, walks the content item linked list, and updates the displayed strings via StringReverseCopyLookup and a content update virtual. Ends by dispatching a state-set virtual (1, 2, or 0) and a finalize virtual.
